Two railway ferries to be built for Kaliningrad The government will allocate approximately 50 billion rubles for the construction of two railway ferries for the Kaliningrad region. The vessels are designed to ensure uninterrupted supplies of goods and raw materials amid attempts at a transport blockade of the area. Funding will come from the National Wealth Fund and the federal budget. The ferries will be built by 2030 at a Russian shipyard using a domestic project. They will operate on the Ust-Luga - Baltiysk route, connecting Leningrad and Kaliningrad regions. The new ships will increase cargo volumes and reduce the region's dependence on land transit. @Slavyangrad
